title: Opinion
author: True_Woodpecker2118
selftext: Just wanna put something out there, No i will not form an anti, anti AI alliance, blind support and tribalism against them is exactly the issue at hand, instead i think we all need to be a little less selfish, need some testing done? Cool same, i see hundreds of these posts a day, all me me me mine mine mine, we have enough open minded people using ai, that we have enough people to test eachothers features and stuff, the first step here is forming a community, but not THAT community, just help eachother out guys.... come on.. test for test, we are all here?

comments.author: PM_Me_Those_
comments.body: I don't want to test a mass majority of the crap i see on here for many reasons... Some of it is simply not good, some of it is just incomplete and some of it very much fits the definition of slop. If you make a game real people want to play, they will playtest it for you eventually, lol. Most of the projects I see in here looks like someone prompted Claude for under a week and then came to Reddit to ask for help... We are not obligated to help eachother and I would even go as far as to say I do not respect the majority of posters here.

replies.author: True_Woodpecker2118
replies.body: Im not disagreeing, just pointing out these people can playtest eachothers
